title: Federal Reserve Board announces approval of the application by Coastal Bend Bancshares, Inc.
raw_text:
August 04, 2026
Federal Reserve Board announces approval of the application by Coastal Bend Bancshares, Inc.
For release at 4:30 p.m. EDT
The Federal Reserve Board on Tuesday announced its approval of the application by Coastal Bend Bancshares, Inc., of Corpus Christi, Texas, to acquire First National Bank in Port Lavaca, of Port Lavaca, Texas.
